name: ble_remote
title: BLE Remote
description: Keyboard, mousepad and game controller with ten saved BLE host slots. Requires BLE-peripheral enabled PAX firmware.
author: PAX workspace
license: Apache-2.0 (app); LVGL MIT; BLE backend GPL-3.0
controls: Keyboard: US-layout taps; Ctrl/Shift/Alt/Win latch for the next key
Mousepad: slide, left/right click, drag toggle and scroll
Game controller: multitouch D-pad and A/B/X/Y/L/R/Select/Start
Hosts: select/connect, disconnect, pair a new device or confirm forgetting a saved pairing
Close or physical L3: return to launcher
changelog: 0.2.0: ten saved hosts and touchscreen pairing, disconnect and forget controls.
